title: Eben Alexander near-death experience

tellings.quote: He has a very interesting scientific outlook of his near-death. And that was like this, like overarching, like, loving energy.

plain: During a near-death experience in 2008, a man named Eben Alexander, the author of a book called Proof of Heaven, met "overarching, like, loving energy". David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who went public with claims about secret UFO programmes, tells Michels this, saying Alexander has "a very interesting scientific outlook" on it. If true, it would hint that consciousness goes on beyond the body.
